input: a temperature in 1/64 deg F at five call sites: fuel_demand_boost_offset (fuel_demand_boost_emaFiltered_compensate), fuel_demand_blend_filtered - fuel_demand_compensation_base_setpoint (fuel_demand_blend_compensate), fuel_demand_boost_input = coolant temperature (fuel_demand_boost_ema_compensate), fuel_demand_boost_input - fuel_demand_compensation_base_setpoint (fuel_demand_boost_compensate), boost_fuel_demand_blend_a capped at 0x1680 = 90 F (cm848_blendBoostAndThrottleFuelDemand)
